dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: Ah la la, ah la la~ Harder, farther, with more interesting designs. This will surely impress Lady Sorush~

dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: I'm still trying to come up with how to make a more interesting race track. Don't be too impatient now.

dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: There will be opportunities for you and Lady Sorush to truly enjoy yourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: Since Lady Sorush mentioned it, remember to come try out the new Lightcall Resonance challenge when you get the chance...

dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: So, I need to plan future challenges just perfectly to achieve the desired effect.

dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: I can't let Lady Sorush feel too bored, but I also can't make them too troublesome either!

dialogues.speaker: Jarjar
dialogues.text: Not busy at all! If you want to chat, come find me any time.
